products.description: Built for movement, comfort, and performance — the Active Motion Lined Shorts are designed to keep you cool and confident through every stride. Made with an outer layer of 75% Nylon and 25% Spandex (170–180 GSM) for lightweight flexibility, and an inner liner of 85% Nylon and 15% Spandex (150–160 GSM) for secure support, these shorts redefine activewear essentials. With angled side pockets, a zippered back pocket, and a hidden inner liner pocket, they combine practicality with sleek, modern aesthetics. The perforated side panels enhance breathability, while the 7-inch inseam and regular fit ensure natural motion and comfort during runs, training sessions, or daily wear. Key Features Fabric: Outer – 75% Nylon, 25% Spandex | Liner – 85% Nylon, 15% Spandex Fit: Regular with 7" inseam for versatile mobility Functional Storage: Angled side pockets, zippered back pocket & liner phone pocket Performance Details: Perforated panels for ventilation & quick-dry comfort Elastic Waistband: Inner drawcord for a secure, adjustable fit Ideal For: Running, gym, travel & everyday activity Care Machine wash according to instructions on the care label.
